presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Near-maximum lengths: long names and roles, references, letter contents, reply slip, date line, seven day labels, stage captions, prop labels, scenario labels and captions, changed fact, four shared facts, guide and neutral note. coordinator decision 2026-09-26 (standing stress rule, AUTHORING item 20): stress lengths capped to the longest values found to fit every ratio at >= 16 px without scaling: capped the party names and roles, the case-file title, the letter contents, the reply slip, the date line, the four stage captions, scenario B's label, both scenario captions, the changed fact, the first shared fact, the guide and the neutral note (about 0.75–0.95 of the near-maximum lengths); every field stays longer than the baseline and all counts are kept (7 days, 4 shared facts). Measured (rendered, frame-based): with near-maximum lengths the 1:1 stacked scenes beside the text column only fit at the 16.4 px floor with each scene 0.51–0.54 of the frame width and heads 33–37 px (floor 0.55 and 45 px); with these caps 1:1 gives 0.58 of the frame width, heads 53 px, 9:16 heads 56 px.
